# Prometheus (PromQL) (`source_type: prometheus`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Runs a PromQL instant query on the agent and reports the scalar result. The agent queries `prometheus_url` when it is set here, otherwise `PROMETHEUS_SERVER_URL` from its own environment. Prometheus auth always comes from the agent's environment variables.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: scalar result of the PromQL query, as returned by the query; Observer does not rescale it

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | yes | string |  |  |
| `prometheus_url` | no | string |  | URL |

## Rules

- The query must return a single number. A query that returns no series reports `no_data` with reason `no_data_for_query`.
- Set `PROMETHEUS_SERVER_URL` on the agent host, or set `prometheus_url` here. `prometheus_url` on createAgent only fills that variable into the install command.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: prometheus
source_config: {"query":"sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\"}[5m])) * 100"}
```
